packageRules.description: Merge non-major GitHub Actions updates once CI passes. The MoonBit image changes moonc and moon prove, so it moves by hand together with the local toolchain, the proofs and the benchmarks; majors stay manual too.
gaato/.github is our own reusable workflow, referenced at main so a change reaches every repository at once.
Reference sources move only with a port (see customManagers), so they wait on the dashboard instead of opening a PR whose SOURCE.sha256 check fails.

customManagers.description: The reference sources the encoders are ported from and checked against byte for byte (brotli for gaato/brotli, libdeflate for gaato/deflate). Moving one means porting its changes and regenerating the pinned vectors, so Renovate only lists the release; SOURCE.sha256 and the port are updated by hand.
